description: This Dart source file defines the ProfileScreen widget, a stateless widget for displaying a user profile and contact options in a Flutter application. It includes UI elements such as app bar, list view, cards for different contact and settings options, and interactions like snack bars and language selection dialog. It also interacts with a SettingsProvider to manage user preferences.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays profile information, contact options, and user preferences in a scrollable list view format.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the profile screen, including UI components and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: _pickLanguage
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing the user to select a language; updates the language preference in SettingsProvider.
